name: open-webui-web-clipper
title: Open WebUI Web Clipper
description: Capture browser content and send it to self-hosted Open WebUI chats and folders.
author: d0xin_d0xin

commands.name: send-to-open-webui
commands.title: Send Web Content
commands.subtitle: Open WebUI
commands.description: Capture a selection, full page, or URL and save it, start a chat, or append it to an existing chat.

commands.name: quick-save-page
commands.title: Save Page
commands.subtitle: Open WebUI
commands.description: Save the current browser page as a Markdown attachment and immediately start the remembered model.

commands.name: quick-save-selection
commands.title: Save Selection
commands.subtitle: Open WebUI
commands.description: Save selected text as a Markdown attachment and immediately start the remembered model.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Open WebUI URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Open WebUI instance, for example https://owui.example.com or http://127.0.0.1:3000.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Open WebUI API Key
preferences.description: API key created in Open WebUI Settings → Account → API Keys.

preferences.name: openAfterSendMode
preferences.title: Open WebUI After Sending
preferences.description: Choose when the clipper should switch from the current browser page to Open WebUI.
